# LLM & Agent Reliability Checklist: Risk Analytics & Trust

**Purpose**: Validate the quality and completeness of requirements concerning LLM extraction accuracy, prompt safety, API reliability, and zero-retention compliance.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Extraction Accuracy & Benchmarking

- [ ] CHK001 Are the accuracy definitions for "exact match" and "missing detection" quantified with explicit tolerance levels (e.g., date formats, numeric rounding)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec explicitly define what constitutes a "synthetic" termsheet for the 30-50 document benchmark corpus? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements for measuring false positives (e.g., hallucinating a value when none exists in the document) defined in the benchmark criteria? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Prompt Safety & Hallucination Handling

- [ ] CHK004 Are system prompt guardrails and output schema enforcement requirements clearly specified to prevent extraction drift? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the exact threshold for triggering a "Conflict" state defined (e.g., semantic mismatch vs. exact string mismatch across the document)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are fallback requirements defined if the LLM returns completely unparseable or schema-violating JSON despite structured output enforcement? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-011]

## API Reliability & Rate Limiting

- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements for handling Vertex AI rate limits (e.g., HTTP 429) and exponential backoff retry strategies defined? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK008 Are maximum latency or timeout thresholds explicitly specified for the LLM extraction request before aborting? [Completeness, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec define the exact UX degradation behavior if the LLM service is completely down or unreachable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Zero-Retention & PII Compliance

- [ ] CHK010 Are the specific fields, patterns, or heuristics that constitute "PII" explicitly enumerated for the client-side redaction requirement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the requirement for "in-memory only" processing verifiable, and does it define what logging (if any) is permitted without violating zero-retention? [Traceability, Spec §FR-033]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
